extDescription.message: Finds the audio and video tracks of the lecture recording you’re watching and sends them to the LectureFlow desktop app (required).

connNotRunning.message: LectureFlow could not be started. Open it, then check again.

connNotInstalled.message: Install or open LectureFlow, then check again.

emptyHint.message: Open a recording and start playing it, then click again.

noAccess.message: The extension cannot read this page.

downloadDisabled.description: Chip: the platform’s switch says the recording is restricted

reportRefused.message: The report was not exported: it may contain personal data.

reportFailed.message: The report could not be made for this page.

reportSaved.message: Report saved. Read it before you share it.

finding_email.message: Something looks like an email address.

finding_identity_field.message: A field looks like a name, user or student ID.

finding_student_id.message: A number looks like a student ID.

finding_name.message: Part of an address looks like a person’s name.

grantDone.message: Allowed. Reload the page so the extension sees the player’s requests from the start.

grantFailed.message: The permission could not be requested.

languageHint.message: Follows your browser unless you choose a language here, for example Cantonese, which browsers do not offer.

profilesHint.message: Profiles name the tracks of a platform. Imported ones are marked “Not reviewed” and take precedence.

importInvalid.message: The profile does not match the schema:

importBlocked.message: This profile cannot be imported: it matches $P1$.
importBlocked.description: Settings: a local profile matching a do-not-handle site is refused; $1 = the host it matches. Followed by unsupportedYoutube or unsupportedCourses.

sitesHint.message: On these sites the extension counts tracks by itself and sees the player’s requests. Elsewhere it acts only when you click its icon.

siteInvalid.message: Enter an address starting with https://

privacyText.message: The extension talks only to LectureFlow on this computer. It reads cookies only when you send a lecture, and only those of the tracks’ sites. Nothing is uploaded.

unsupportedTitle.message: LectureFlow does not work on this site

unsupportedText.message: LectureFlow is for your school’s lecture recordings.

unsupportedYoutube.message: LectureFlow does not handle YouTube. It is for your school’s lecture recordings.
unsupportedYoutube.description: Do-not-handle site: YouTube (src/lib/blocklist.js). Below unsupportedTitle in the popup; also in settings when adding the site.

unsupportedCourses.message: LectureFlow does not handle online course platforms (MOOCs and paid courses). It is for your school’s lecture recordings.
unsupportedCourses.description: Do-not-handle site: MOOCs and online / paid course platforms (Udemy, Coursera…). Below unsupportedTitle in the popup; also in settings when adding the site.

blockedEmbedNote.message: Embedded YouTube or online course platform content on this page was skipped: LectureFlow does not handle it.
blockedEmbedNote.description: No tracks found, and the page embeds YouTube or a course platform, which detection skipped

discNotInstalled.message: LectureFlow was not found. Install it and open it once, then click “Check again”.

discNotRunning.message: LectureFlow did not start. Open it yourself, then click “Check again”.

discProtocol.message: LectureFlow and the extension do not match. Update both to the latest version.

discUnsupportedOs.message: LectureFlow runs on Windows and on Macs with Apple silicon only.

downloadDisabledOverridden.description: Chip after the reminder was confirmed

observeNeedsGrant.message: Allow automatic detection on this site and reload the page to see the platform’s restriction setting and the full recording.
observeNeedsGrant.description: Profile reads a page response; site not authorized

observeNeedsReload.message: Reload the recording page to see the platform’s restriction setting and the full recording.
observeNeedsReload.description: Profile reads a page response not seen yet

courseNone.message: LectureFlow has no courses yet. Create one in LectureFlow first.

dataNote.message: Sending gives the selected tracks’ addresses, this page’s address and the cookies those addresses need to LectureFlow on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
dataNote.description: Data note under the popup’s button

oneEach.message: One audio and one picture at most; two with Two cameras

blockedImported.message: This lecture is already in LectureFlow.

blockedProtected.message: This stream is protected by digital rights management (DRM). LectureFlow does not handle protected content.

againFailed.message: The last fetch did not finish. You can send it again.

againCancelled.message: The last fetch was cancelled. You can send it again.

closeHint.message: You can close this window; fetching carries on in LectureFlow.

doneHint.message: Fetched. The lecture has been created and goes on to transcription.

failedHint.message: Fetching did not finish. LectureFlow shows why and can retry it.

refreshText.message: Fetching this lecture stopped: its sign-in data has expired. Click “Resume” to continue with this page’s fresh sign-in data.

refreshButton.description: Primary button of the needs_refresh view

errCourseGone.message: This course no longer exists in LectureFlow. Choose another one.

errStale.message: The page has changed. Close this window and click the extension icon again.

errProtected.message: Copyright protected (DRM) tracks cannot be sent.

errNotRunning.message: LectureFlow is not responding. Open it and try again.

errTimeout.message: LectureFlow did not answer in time. Try again.

errRefreshGone.message: LectureFlow no longer has this fetch. You can send the lecture again.

errSiteBlocked.message: LectureFlow refused this task: it does not handle YouTube or online course platforms, only your school’s lecture recordings.
errSiteBlocked.description: Error: LectureFlow refused the send (downloads.site_blocked): the page or a track is on YouTube or a course platform. Same text as LectureFlow’s errors.downloads.site_blocked.

errGeneric.message: That did not work ($P1$). Try again.

reportsHint.message: Export a redacted detection report to write or improve a profile. A recording page appears here once you have clicked the extension icon on it.

inpageNote.message: Cookies are read only when you click “Send”, and go only to LectureFlow on this computer

profileSource.description: Lecture card: which profile named it

courseLast.description: Suffix of the course used last

rowDownloading.description: List row: a lecture being fetched

restrictedNotice.message: This stream may be restricted by your lecturer’s or university’s policy. LectureFlow only fetches streams you have access to, to this computer, for your personal accessible learning (transcription/translation). Please make sure you follow your school’s rules. You will be reminded once more before sending.
restrictedNotice.description: The user’s text, verbatim (it says 您)

restrictedConfirm.message: LectureFlow only fetches streams you have access to, to this computer, for your personal accessible learning (transcription/translation). Please make sure you follow your school’s rules.

bulkRestrictedConfirm.message: $P1$ of them may be restricted by your lecturer’s or university’s policy. LectureFlow only fetches streams you have access to, to this computer, for your personal accessible learning (transcription/translation). Please make sure you follow your school’s rules.

restrictedNoticeQuiet.message: This stream may be restricted by your lecturer’s or university’s policy. LectureFlow only fetches streams you have access to, to this computer, for your personal accessible learning (transcription/translation). Please make sure you follow your school’s rules.
restrictedNoticeQuiet.description: The restricted notice (the user’s own text) without its last sentence, shown when the reminder is off for this platform

restrictedRemember.message: Don’t remind me again for this platform ($P1$)
restrictedRemember.description: Check box in the restricted reminder; $1 is the platform name

restrictedRememberedNote.message: You turned off this reminder for $P1$. You can turn it back on in the extension settings.
restrictedRememberedNote.description: Line under the restricted notice when the reminder is off for this platform; $1 is the platform name

restrictedHint.message: Before you send a recording that may be restricted, the extension reminds you. Platforms for which you turned that reminder off are listed here; turn it back on to be reminded every time again.

restrictedEmpty.message: No platform: you are reminded every time.

restrictedSince.description: Settings: row detail; $1 is a date (YYYY-MM-DD)

restrictedForget.description: Settings: button that undoes “don’t remind me again”

presetMain.description: Choice: the full recording, or main audio + first picture

presetMainNone.message: No track here can be sent

presetAudioNone.message: There is no separate audio track

offerEmbedded.message: This page embeds $P1$. Allow $P1$ sites and reload the page to send from here.
offerEmbedded.description: Popup: a platform frame not readable yet

offerOpaque.message: This page embeds content the extension cannot read. If it is $P1$ (for example ReCap in Canvas), allow $P1$ sites and reload the page.

errInfoFailed.message: Could not read this lecture from the platform ($P1$).

bulkSummary.message: $P1$ lectures: $P2$ already imported (matched by session and title), $P3$ being fetched,

bulkQueueNote.message: Queued in order; how many are fetched at once is set in LectureFlow (3 by default)

bulkPageOnly.message: Only the lectures listed on this page; on other pages, click again there.

bulkNoTrack.message: No track matches the chosen content

grantCookieHosts.message: These tracks are on other sites. If fetching them needs those sites’ cookies, allow them too (optional):
grantCookieHosts.description: Popup: above check boxes, one per other host whose cookies a send would read

grantAllow.description: Popup: button that asks the browser for the page’s site and the ticked hosts

trustedHeading.description: Settings: section heading (sites the platform’s pages may be embedded in, with in-page confirmation)

trustedHint.message: When a recording platform’s page is embedded in one of these sites (your school’s Canvas, for example), you can confirm sending right on the page. Embedded in any other site, the button opens a LectureFlow confirmation window, so that another site cannot trick you into clicking.

trustedEmpty.message: No trusted sites yet: a button embedded in another site always opens the confirmation window.

trustedSince.description: Settings: row detail; $1 is a date (YYYY-MM-DD)

importReplaceConfirm.message: This file has the same id as the built-in profile “$P1$ $P2$”. Once imported, it replaces the built-in version and the card marks it “Not reviewed”. Replace it?
importReplaceConfirm.description: Settings: an imported file has the id of a built-in profile; $1 its name, $2 its version

importReplace.description: Settings: button, import the file in place of the built-in profile

profileReplaces.description: Settings: under a local profile that replaces a built-in one; $1 is the built-in version

profileInactive.message: Not in use: same id as a built-in profile. Import it again and confirm.
profileInactive.description: Settings: chip on a local profile with a built-in profile’s id that was never confirmed

embedWhy.message: This recording page is embedded in a page of $P1$. So that another site cannot trick you into clicking, confirm in this window.
embedWhy.description: Confirmation window: why it opened; $1 is the site the recording page is embedded in (an origin)

embedWhyUnknown.message: This recording page is embedded in another site’s page, and the browser did not tell the extension which site. So that another site cannot trick you into clicking, confirm in this window.
embedWhyUnknown.description: Confirmation window: why it opened, when the browser does not tell the site

embedFrom.description: Confirmation window: the recording page’s host; $1 is a host name

embedTrust.message: From now on, confirm on the page itself in $P1$
embedTrust.description: Confirmation window: check box; $1 is the site (an origin)

confirmGone.message: This confirmation window no longer works: the recording page was closed or reloaded. Go back to the page and click the button again.
confirmGone.description: Confirmation window: the page it belonged to is gone

errConfirmWindow.message: Send from the LectureFlow confirmation window.
errConfirmWindow.description: Error: this frame must confirm in the extension’s window
